subject: Urgent: Capacity allocation conflict between Auron and Orion - immediate plan needed
messages:
From: Kendra Holtz <kendra.holtz@orionai.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: procure@aurum-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 07 Aug 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: urgent additional dedicated slots for Orion Q4 peak

Jonas / Redwood team —

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. We just closed an acceleration agreement with a key partner and our model footprint will spike during early Nov-Dec. Based on initial estimates we need an additional 48 dedicated GPU slots (A100-equivalent) for an 8-week window starting 2028-11-01. Current committed capacity (through our reserved contract) won’t cover the burst.

We appreciate any options for temporary tranche increases, reserved burst lanes, or prioritized routing so we don't see latency degradation for enterprise customers. Tim from procurement is looped for any paperwork.

Can you confirm feasibility and an approximate cost delta by EOD?

—Kendra Holtz
VP Product, OrionAI

Attachments: orion_scv_request.pdf (pdf, 340KB)

-----
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Kendra Holtz <kendra.holtz@orionai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Aug 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: urgent additional dedicated slots for Orion Q4 peak

Kendra —

Thanks — and congrats on the partner deal. I want to be transparent: we have a peak contention window in early Nov. There are two other large committed deals (Auron Analytics) that have overlapping SLAs and reserved slices. At present, our pool utilization forecast for that week shows >95% reservation utilization without changes.

I’m looping Laura and Marissa to propose options. High-level possibilities:
- Short-term tranche bump (if physical capacity available) with pro-rata billing;
- Burst routing onto shared Best-Effort pool with throttled throughput guarantees;
- Trade: shift Auron's non-critical batch jobs to scheduled maintenance window in exchange for temporary capacity for Orion.

We need to align by EOD so engineering can lock scheduling.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

-----
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Kendra Holtz <kendra.holtz@orionai.com>, Tim Blake <tim.blake@aurum-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Aug 2028 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: urgent additional dedicated slots for Orion Q4 peak

Quick proposal from capacity/sales side —

1) If Orion signs an 8-week committed burst addendum (minimum 40 slots) by 2028-08-15, we can allocate up to 36 physical slots from our flexible pool and guarantee warming on a subset to reduce cold-start latency. Price ~ +45% on top of dedicated rate for burst window.

2) For the remaining delta (12 slots), recommend Best-Effort overflow with priority shaping (token-level caps) — cheaper but not SLA-backed.

3) For Auron (current reserved customer), propose a temporary batch-recapture: move 20% of scheduled nightly ETL runs into a staggered window (we’ve identified low-impact segments) which frees up ~12-16 slots during peak daytime hours. In exchange, offer Auron a one-time credit and extended support hours.

Risks: if multiple customers request burst concurrently we may still not satisfy hard spike — engineering needs final confirmation to implement KV-cache warming and prefetch policies.

-Marissa
Account Lead, Dedicated Sales
Attachment: auron_capacity_plan.xlsx (xls, 1.2MB)

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Kendra Holtz <kendra.holtz@orionai.com>, Tim Blake <tim.blake@aurum-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Aug 2028 13:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: urgent additional dedicated slots for Orion Q4 peak

Engineering constraints and realistic lead times:
- Physical procurement (if we needed to spin up new nodes) is a 6–9 week timeline — too slow for Nov 1 if order placed post 8/15.
- We can re-slice existing pools, but re-slicing needs customer consent where contracts guarantee reserved islands. For Auron specifically, their SLA has a reserved tranche clause that requires 14 days notice and compensation for any reduction.
- Technical mitigations we can implement immediately (within 72 hours) if an agreement is signed: KV-cache pre-warm, model sharding optimizations, prioritized batching for Orion routes, and pre-populating activation caches which can reduce slot count by ~15% effectively.

Bottom line: we can meet a partial portion of Orion's ask via operational optimizations and negotiated tranche rearrangement now; anything beyond ~36 guaranteed slots for the window requires contract-level tradeoffs or new capacity.

-Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime

-----
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Kendra Holtz <kendra.holtz@orionai.com>, Tim Blake <tim.blake@aurum-analytics.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Aug 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: urgent additional dedicated slots for Orion Q4 peak

Team —

I reviewed contracts and the simple fact: Auron has language that protects their reserved tranche and entitles them to compensation if we degrade their reserved capacity. We cannot unilaterally pull slots without either: (a) Auron agreement to shift batch windows, or (b) offering a financial make-good.

Decision: prioritize contractual commitments. We will:
- Offer Orion a 36-slot guaranteed tranche (operational mitigations applied) for the requested window at the burst rate Marissa noted.
- Offer the remaining 12 slots via priority Best-Effort overflow.
- For any additional guaranteed capacity beyond 36, pursue a documented trade with Auron: propose schedule shifts that free 12–16 slots during daytime hours in exchange for a credit of one month of fees + three months of 24x7 support. Marissa, please draft the trade proposal; Ben, run the numbers on the credit exposure.

We need to communicate this to Orion by COB today. Jonas, lead the external comms. Karthik, please prepare the KV-warm plan for the 36-slot tranche and an ops checklist we can send to Orion to reduce their effective slot needs.

Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success & Operations

-----
From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Kendra Holtz <kendra.holtz@orionai.com>, Tim Blake <tim.blake@aurum-analytics.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 07 Aug 2028 17:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: urgent additional dedicated slots for Orion Q4 peak

Kendra / Tim —

Thanks again for the heads-up and congrats on the partner momentum. Quick summary and next steps (operational slot commitment while we pursue a trade):

What we can guarantee today (pending paper):
- 36 dedicated GPU slots for 2028-11-01 through 2028-12-27 with KV-cache warm and prioritized batching — we can implement cache warming within 72 hours of signed addendum.
- 12 additional slots offered on Best-Effort overflow (no SLA) that will lower latency for many queries but not guaranteed under extreme spikes.

Trade path to enlarge guaranteed capacity:
- We’ve identified a potential swap with Auron to free ~12–16 daytime slots. Redwood will propose: one month of credit + three months of elevated support for Auron if they shift 20% of batch ETL to off-peak windows. If Auron agrees, we can bump Orion to 48 guaranteed slots.

Action items:
- Orion: sign the 8-week burst addendum covering 36 guaranteed slots + 12 BE by 2028-08-15 so engineering has time to pre-warm and schedule. (link to draft addendum: https://drive.redwood.com/s/auron-capacity-plan)
- Redwood: Marissa to send pricing addendum; Karthik to prepare KV-warm checklist; Ben to provide credit exposure P&L for Auron trade by EOD.

We appreciate flexibility; we’ll keep you posted on the Auron negotiation timeline.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: auron_capacity_plan.xlsx (internal planning workbook), orion_scv_request.pdf (external request)
